messages.content: amar sathe ekjon flirt korche kintu bujhtechi na serious naki just moja
Ki kore bolche, specific example dite paro?
compliment dey onek, but plan kore dekha korte chai na kokhono
Eta ekta pattern - words onek, action kom. Serious interest thakle usually actual dekha kora ba concrete plan er dike move kore, khali compliment e thake na.
Ekbar direct kore proposal koro dekha korar - jodi avoid kore ba excuse dite thake, tahole answer already paye gecho. Attention pete valo lage, kintu action e clarity ashe.
